html:
Experience a magical tropical evening aboard Emperor Cruises as the sun sets over Nha Trang Bay. Enjoy a delicious 5-course seafood dinner while being serenaded by live musicians, with the stars, moon, and city lights as your backdrop. The attentive staff ensure an unforgettable romantic cruise experience.

DETAILED ITINERARY

15:35 – 16:00
Pick-up from your hotel and transfer to Vinh Truong Island Waterway Port to board Emperor Cruises.

16:20 – 16:30
Guests are transferred by tender from the port to the main Emperor Cruises boat.

16:30 – 18:00
Upon arrival on board, you are welcomed by the Experiences Manager with a welcome drink. Receive an introduction to Nha Trang Bay, local culture, cuisine, history, the emperor’s legacy, and safety precautions. Begin cruising through the stunning landscape of Nha Trang Bay as the sun sets.

18:00 – 19:30
Enjoy cocktails and wines on the sundeck while live musicians (violin and guitar) play against the breathtaking backdrop of stars, the moon, and city lights.

Indulge in a 5 course seafood dinner, with main course options including lobster, Australian beef, or salmon, served by the attentive Emperor Cruises team.

20:00
Conclude your romantic evening with drinks or cocktails on the lounge or sundeck before returning to the port. Shuttle transfers will take you back to your hotel.

PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 72

BENEFITS INCLUDED

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off in central Nha Trang

  • Cocktail party and canapés on the sundeck

  • Experiences Manager on board (English, Russian, Korean, Vietnamese)

  • Seafood 5-course dinner on board with main course options: Lobster / Australian Beef / Salmon

  • Unlimited drinks: house wine, cocktails, liquor, local beer, soft drinks, fruit juice, tea, coffee, mineral water

  • Live music (violin + guitar)

  • Free Wi-Fi

NOTE

  • Timetable may vary by ±30 minutes depending on weather and sea conditions.

  • Final pick-up time will be confirmed one day prior to the cruise.

ONBOARD SERVICES

  • 24-hour reception and security

  • Mini bar

  • Restaurant

  • Newspapers, magazines, and chess

  • Languages spoken: English, Russian, Korean, Vietnamese
